observations.mechanism: At frame 0000/t=0 the red floating body is visibly above the initially level blue fluid in the finite tank. The first contact sheet shows early sloshing and approach; around t≈2.4 s a central impact/splash envelopes the body, followed by submerged/partly submerged motion and redistribution. From roughly 3.6–6 s the body and free surface settle through large waves; the later sheets show smaller residual waves and a bounded body response through t≈12 s.
observations.initial_state: The initial isometric and side views show the full tank, fluid volume, fixed boundaries, and floating body with no obvious gross initial overlap or malformed geometry.
observations.all_contact_sheets: All 11 chronological sheets were viewed. The sequence is continuous from frame 0000 through frame 0240; the full-domain camera keeps the tank and event visible. No obvious severe wall/tank penetration, explosive particle cloud, blank/cropped event, or premature visual termination was seen.
observations.key_frames: Viewed frames 0, 24, 48, 72, 96, 120, 168, 192, and 240. These cover initial release, early contact/splash, mid-event response, settling, and the terminal saved state. The body remains visible and the fluid response is visually bounded by the tank.
observations.failure_screen: No visual rejection trigger was observed in the reviewed PNGs. This is a delegated visual screen and does not certify numerical accuracy, conservation, convergence, Q-N/Q-E, or production approval.
